title: Body-extractor rejections bypass the JSON error envelope
evidence: src/lib.rs:151 and :226 use axum's `Json<T>` extractor directly; malformed JSON, a wrong field type (e.g. "year": "x" -> 422) or a missing Content-Type (415) return axum's text/plain rejection, contradicting README.md 'Errors are returned as {"error": "<message>"}'. tests/integration.rs:151 checks only the status, not the body.
suggestion: Accept `Result<Json<T>, JsonRejection>` (or a custom extractor) and map rejections to ApiError::BadRequest so every error is JSON.

title: PUT cannot clear year or isbn
evidence: src/lib.rs:245-246 `req.year.or(existing.year)` / `req.isbn.clone().or(existing.isbn.clone())` — an explicit null is indistinguishable from an omitted field, so optional fields can never be unset.
suggestion: Use a double-Option (e.g. serde_with::rust::double_option) to distinguish null from absent.

title: PUT validation reuses validate_required with placeholder arguments
evidence: src/lib.rs:236-241 calls `validate_required(title, Some("placeholder"))` and `validate_required(Some("placeholder"), author)` to validate one field at a time.
suggestion: Split into a per-field validator so the intent is explicit.

title: Mutex lock().unwrap() in every handler
evidence: src/lib.rs:159, 178, 215, 228, 265 `state.db.lock().unwrap()` — one panic while holding the lock poisons it and every later request panics.
suggestion: Map the PoisonError to ApiError::Internal, or use a connection pool (r2d2/deadpool).

title: GET / service descriptor added beyond spec
evidence: src/lib.rs:133-141 and :279; tests/integration.rs:86 root_returns_service_descriptor. Added after `hermes verify` readiness probe polled `/` (_agent_stdout.log).
